profiles.grammar: Generic UIExpr evaluator over immutable dedicated U128/Bool/list/tree values, named calls and shallow ordered patterns
profiles.work: 37 machine rule cases cost1 each occurrence; 5 administration and 71 pure helper cases cost0; counts are source membership, not execution frequency
profiles.terminal: uiRet with empty stack and uiError publish at zero even with no fuel
profiles.zero_fuel: Nonterminal UIControl -> uiExhausted at zero before any positive-fuel machine transition
profiles.frame_cap: Positive-fuel uiPush accepts D<L; rejects error4 at D>=L and costs1 either case

profiles.grammar: Finite algorithm/control abstraction for Factorial/ListSum/TreeSum; not K expression evaluator
profiles.work: Running tick with remaining>0 calls charged exactly once before evaluate/suspend/return/refuse; consumed+1 remaining-1 attempted+1. Exhaust tick consumed0 attempted+1. Observe/stutter0. Terminal return costs1.
profiles.frame_cap: push computes frames.length()+1 and refuses only depth>MAX_FRAMES; it adds no independent charge. applyTick already charged; cap refusal therefore retains that tick charge.
profiles.saved_pending_return: PendingReturn(acc) plus full Machine remainder; observations do not reconstruct an environment
profiles.observations: canObserve Waiting and (ready or observations==0); false once before a ready event in concrete demo; ready is modeled condition only
profiles.source_scope_limit: No generic function/environment table, exact U128 domain, arbitrary UIExpr grammar, general declarations or financial semantics.

profiles.work: One per helper event and one per separately completed legacy machine rule; startup/terminal/error publication0; accounting target conditional and unproved
profiles.status: Normal proposed event inventory only; I shared schemas and S exact failure/allocation rows unresolved

pure val initialHeap: int -> Node = Map(
    0 -> Nil,
    1 -> Cons({head: 3, tail: 0}),
    2 -> Cons({head: 2, tail: 1}),
    3 -> Cons({head: 1, tail: 2}),

    5 -> Leaf(5),

quint_definitions.source_text:
pure def initial(sc: Scenario): Machine = {
    val budget = if (sc == ExhaustCase) 2 else 32
    {
      phase: Running,
      program: if (sc == ListCase) ListSum else if (sc == TreeCase) TreeSum else Factorial,
      control: Evaluate,
      arg: if (sc == BoundCase) 4 else 3,
      cursor: if (sc == TreeCase) 7 else 3,
      acc: 0, frames: List(), heap: initialHeap,
      total: budget, remaining: budget, consumed: 0, attempted: 0,
      yieldEnabled: sc == YieldCase, yielded: false, pending: NoPending,
      observations: 0, acceptedEvents: 0, boundary: 0,
      checkpoint: {acc: 0, frames: List(), arg: 0, cursor: 0, consumed: 0},
      result: NoResult, reason: NoReason, maxDepth: 0, visited: Set(),
    }
  }
